narration: You've been making mortgage payments feeling like a homeowner. But there's a chart your bank has never shown you — and it changes everything.
visual: Dark background. House outline in amber rises from bottom. Pulsing question mark appears next to house. White text: 'YOUR BANK HAS NEVER SHOWN YOU THIS CHART'.

narration: On a 30-year mortgage at today's rates, 86% of your first payment is pure interest. Only 14 cents of every dollar actually reduces what you owe.
visual: Light background. Animated bar chart split: massive red bar labeled '86% BANK / INTEREST', tiny amber bar labeled '14% YOUR HOME / PRINCIPAL'. Bank icon and house icon flank the bars.

narration: After five full years on a $350,000 loan, you've sent the bank $136,000. Your actual balance has only dropped by $20,500. Here's what that looks like.
visual: Dark background. Two animated bars growing from zero: tall red bar ($136K PAID) vs tiny amber bar ($20,500 EQUITY). Counter animates up. Text: 'YOU KEPT LESS THAN 15%'.

narration: Banks front-load interest on purpose so they get paid first. They're counting on you selling or refinancing before the math ever flips in your favor.
visual: Light background. SVG house on left, animated red arrows and dollar signs flowing right to bank building. Text: 'THIS ISN'T AN ACCIDENT'.

narration: Here's the flip side. Paying just $200 extra per month saves $51,000 in interest and cuts six years off your loan. Same math, different direction.
visual: Dark background. Calculator icon. '+$200/MONTH' label. Two animated counters tick up: '$51,000 SAVED' in green and '6 YRS SOONER'. Text: 'THE MATH WORKS IN REVERSE TOO'.

narration: Pull up your mortgage statement and demand the full amortization table. What you see will change how you think about every payment you've ever made.
visual: Light background. SVG phone showing amortization table rows with tiny principal vs large interest columns. Text: 'PULL UP YOUR MORTGAGE STATEMENT RIGHT NOW'. CTA button: 'DEMAND THE FULL AMORTIZATION TABLE'.
